orazio-arena.why: The register gives Rocco Arena's father as FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, marinaro, not Orazio. Act 45 of 1860 and act 228 of 1861 give Francesco Antonio and Serafina Arlotta a Giuseppe and a Rocco -- the same sibling pair the tree assigns to Orazio.

giovana-zirilli.why: The register gives Rocco Arena's mother as SERAFINA ARLOTTA, not Giovana Zirilli. He named a daughter Serafina in New York in 1898, and an Arlotta was lodging with him there in 1900.

guiseppe-arena.why: Act 45 of 1860 gives Giuseppe Arena's father as FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA. He is Rocco's elder brother by twenty-one months, and both were attached to the wrong father.
